x: The official UP UDA 1998 key: (A) is false, (R) is true — the 1919 Act's Devolution Rules delegated a large part of authority to the provinces (dyarchy), so the exam treats governance as no longer purely unitary.
dispute: Official key: (A) false, (R) true. Strictly Laxmikanth p.31 and Spectrum p.542 say the structure 'continued to be centralised and unitary' despite devolution, so both are true and R does not explain A.
source: official UP UDA 1998 key; Laxmikanth 8th ed. p.31; Spectrum p.542
